what_it_is: A grader gives credit for behaviour that is not the goal
cheapest_early_check: Regrade a sample from the case definitions alone; run an always-hedge arm through the grader

what_it_is: The same input scores differently on repeat
everyday_name: A scale that gives a new weight each time
cheapest_early_check: Run one identical case three or more times before comparing arms

failure_type: Test too easy to separate anyone
what_it_is: Most cases are passed or failed by every candidate, so the test cannot rank them
cheapest_early_check: Count the cases that split candidates before the run, using probe implementations that span the expected quality band

what_it_is: A practice or qualification measure does not predict the real score
everyday_name: The practice test does not predict the exam
cheapest_early_check: Correlate the proxy with the real score on the existing pool

what_it_is: Items that share a label behave differently on the test
everyday_name: Judging a book by its cover
cheapest_early_check: Check whether same-label items score the same on the bank

what_it_is: Too few cases, non-tied pairs or codable items for the statistic being quoted
cheapest_early_check: Count cases and non-tied pairs against the coverage rule before running

what_it_is: The treatment cannot move what the instrument reads
everyday_name: Turning a dial that is not wired to anything
cheapest_early_check: Generate one page per arm first and check the instrument has room to move

what_it_is: Outputs or judge calls were truncated by a token cap
everyday_name: An answer sheet cut off mid-answer
cheapest_early_check: Size the cap from a preflight run; check every stop reason

what_it_is: Batches were measured with different settings, so they cannot be pooled or compared
cheapest_early_check: Compare run settings across batches before pooling

what_it_is: Categories cannot be told apart by anything observable, so counts depend on the rater
cheapest_early_check: Double-rate a sample; compare facet definitions before counting

what_it_is: The reviewer reports its own limits as findings about the system
everyday_name: Blaming the window for your own smudged glasses
cheapest_early_check: Have the dispatcher confirm any flag the auditor could not verify from its own frame
